reserves.name: USDC and yield-bearing USDC strategy positions

reserveReview.rationale: StoneYield documents that USDC deposits are routed by its StrategyRouter into a Venus-integrated ERC-4626 vault, where vUSDC accrues lending yield. The current strategy position is retained as one linked USDC protocol-position slice because the disclosures do not publish a durable allocation among Venus positions or future strategy modules. Write-time re-open 2026-07-30: StoneYield contract-design and yield-generation pages still describe the USDC deposit flow StakeableAsset→StrategyRouter→VenuSTUSDVault→Venus with a 7% protocol fee, and the public contract repository still lists StrategyRouter 0x563f48aAD50a75Ef3662827a4d536dbd46aBb5a2 and VenusUSDCVault 0x375Defe9293671a4459CF7206Ac6f440d0Eb0970 as the reserve path; 100% USDC/protocol-position envelope retained. No audit report, proof-of-reserves, or third-party attestation over the reserve path is published (stoneyield.io claims 'Audited BSC contracts' without naming an auditor or report), so the latest assurance scope remains issuer documentation plus verified on-chain contract sources only.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current StoneYield contract-design and yield-generation documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The direct reserve relationship is USDC routed through the documented StrategyRouter and Venus path. Current vUSDC balances, allocation weights, and any later strategy-module allocation are not published as a durable composition.
